title: LSD-47 STUFFING TUBE FOR MK137 MOD 10 LAUNCHER; REPLACE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC YOKOSUKA.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR  YOKOSUKA
detail_text: This is a Synopsis notice only. This is not a solicitation or request for proposal and no contract will be awarded from this notice. This information in this notification is subject to change and in no way binds the US Government to award a contract. USS RUSHMORE (LSD-47) STUFFING TUBE FOR MK137 MOD 10 LAUNCHER; REPLACE POP from 08/10/2026 to 10/31/2026 Place of Performance: Commander, Fleet Activities Sasebo (CFAS) in Japan. The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Yokosuka, Site Sasebo, intends to issue a competitive solicitation restricted to Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) and Agreement for Boat Repair (ABR) holders located in Japan. In accordance with DFARS 225.1103(3), this procurement is intended only for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in Japan. To be eligible for award, offerors must be able to demonstrate their authorization to perform the required work within Japan at the time of proposal submission. Please ensure that your company meets these criteria and maintains all necessary documentation to verify its status and compliance with Japanese laws and regulations.
